drafts.title: Temperature
drafts.pitch: The user fiddles with a temperature dial on the wall; Cursor goes from robotic at zero to unhinged at two, and asked what Tilde is set to, Tilde says "Off."
drafts.reason: Strong flat-to-unhinged visual and a good dry button, but the wall dial is a thin fit with the room and phone-call world.

drafts.title: Bright Room
drafts.pitch: Three days after the meter was paid the room is still bright and the handset still quiet; Null won't let Cursor turn the light down. Tilde: "Now we can see nobody." From Pil-Tae's comment on 025-the-meter (issue #62).
drafts.reason: Good Tilde closer, but four static talking panels that mostly repeat The Meter's premise, and 'Beats both dark' is muddy.
